description: Subclass 189 (and 491 family sponsored) invitation round history for one ANZSCO occupation: each round date, whether the occupation was invited and the points cutoff, estimated invitations per recent round, the occupation's current 65+ point pool, the next round date Home Affairs has announced, and One U Education's frozen forecast of the next cutoff. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

name: get_189_invitations
title: Get subclass 189 invitation history
